# 1 Enoch Chapter 35 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Ge'ez MS; cf. 4QEn (Aramaic) | **Section:** Book of Watchers

---

**1** After that I saw similar portals to the west, at the edge of the great earth — three portals of heaven, standing open there just like those I had seen in the north.

---

*PNEUMA notes: Dynamic equivalence rendering. Chapter 35 is a single verse — the shortest chapter in 1 Enoch — describing the western portals as analogous to the northern portals of chapter 34. "Similar portals" and "just like those I had seen in the north" make the cross-reference explicit for modern readers.*
